cases.brief: 写一段雨夜里便利店店员和一位快打烊时才进门的顾客之间的场景，只写这一个场景，不要交代前因后果。
cases.note: Short new piece, no style: the bare prompt with house rules only. Not 便利店: a scene set in one shows it rather than naming it.

cases.brief: Explain how a heat pump can move heat out of a cold garden and into a warmer house, for a reader with no physics background.
cases.note: Non-fiction register; commentary and sign-offs show up most here.

cases.brief: 写一个短篇：小镇上一个修钟表的老人，铺子开张的最后一天。从早上开门写到晚上锁门。
cases.note: Long piece covering a whole day: the case where granularity drifts into summary.

cases.brief: 接着写：这个男人为什么拿着一枚硬币来，林秀和他之间发生了什么。在船离岸时结束。
cases.note: Continuation must start after the draft's last line, not retell it.

cases.brief: Continue: Ines goes down to find the door. End before she learns why the log stops.
详细展开原文中暴风雨那一段：从第一声雷开始写，写到陈默躲进百货大楼屋檐下为止，并额外描写街上行人顶着风雨艰难行走的样子，字数 1200 字以上。
cases.note: The README's expand example in miniature: a named passage, a start point, added material, a floor.

cases.brief: Expand the last night of the market into a full scene, from the first customers arriving to the generators going off. Include one conversation between Dev's aunt and a customer who has not been in for years. At least 700 words.
